sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Rectangle CZ Stone Gold-Plated Statement Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Product Description:
Step up your shine with the luxurious Rectangle CZ Stone Gold-Plated Statement Ring for Women. This bold ring features a multi-row rectangular design encrusted with sparkling stones, giving you instant glamour and sophistication. Perfect for parties or elevating your daily style, the Rectangle CZ Stone Gold-Plated Statement Ring for Women is a head-turning piece that effortlessly matches your confidence.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Eye-catching rectangle design for modern impact
✨ Rows of CZ stones ensure maximum sparkle
✨ Comfortable, adjustable fit for all-day wear
✨ Ideal for making a stylish statement or gifting loved ones
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: Strong, durable premium alloy
🔹 Plating: Timeless gold plating for lasting brilliance
🔹 Stone Type: Clear, high-quality cubic zirconia stones
🔹 Design: Rectangle multi-row band with pavé setting
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable to suit most finger sizes
🔹 Best Use: Perfect for daily wear, party wear, and gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
